description: Widths written with clamp, min, max and calc over a percentage, percentages in max-width and margin, and the intrinsic keywords

florui.css: .wrap { width: 200px; background-color: #223; } .wrap > div { height: 12px; margin-bottom: 3px; background-color: #556; } .clamp { width: clamp(50px, 30%, 100px); } .min { width: min(80%, 120px); background-color: #e85 !important; } .max { width: max(20%, 30px); } .calc { width: calc(50% - 10px); background-color: #4c8 !important; } .maxw { width: 100%; max-width: 30%; } .margin { margin-left: 10%; background-color: #48c !important; } .fit { color: transparent; width: fit-content; height: auto !important; background-color: #a4b !important; } .maxc { color: transparent; width: max-content; height: auto !important; background-color: #fc0 !important; } .minc { color: transparent; width: min-content; height: auto !important; background-color: #e33 !important; } .stretch { width: stretch; margin-left: 20px; }
